verdict.rationale: Natural-language control is a fair axis for a Mac-to-iPhone/iPad screen-sharing app. The evidence, however, documents only direct input: touch, trackpad gestures, keyboard, Apple Pencil, menus and an app launcher. Nothing shows the product accepting or interpreting natural-language commands, and typed text sent to the Mac is ordinary keystroke relay, not command interpretation.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands
